import sys
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import json

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/runner/work/sdlc-framework/sdlc-framework/plugin")
from gate import gate, checks

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SCENARIO = sys.argv[2]


def git(*args):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT)] + list(args), check=True, capture_output=True)


def write(p, text):
    p = Path(p)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


# reset to a fresh branch off main for this scenario
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "checkout", "-q", "main"], check=True)
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "-C", str(ROOT), "branch", "-q", "-D", "scenario"], capture_output=True
)
git("checkout", "-q", "-b", "scenario")

change_dir = ROOT / "changes" / "0001-x"

if SCENARIO == "undeclared_drop":
    (ROOT / "tests" / "test_keep.py").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop a test undeclared")
elif SCENARIO == "declared_files":
    write(
        change_dir / "plan.md",
        "# Plan: x\n\n## Files that change\n- `tests/test_keep.py` — removed\n\n## Proof\nnone\n",
    )
    (ROOT / "tests" / "test_keep.py").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop declared in files")
elif SCENARIO == "declared_proof":
    write(
        change_dir / "plan.md",
        "# Plan: x\n\n## Files that change\n- none\n\n## Proof\n- ratchet: tests may fall, because retired\n",
    )
    (ROOT / "tests" / "test_keep.py").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop declared via proof")
elif SCENARIO == "plan_edit_same_commit":
    (ROOT / "tests" / "test_keep.py").unlink()
    write(
        change_dir / "plan.md",
        "# Plan: x\n\n## Files that change\n- `tests/test_keep.py` — removed\n\n## Proof\nnone\n",
    )
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop and edit plan.md in the same commit")
elif SCENARIO == "rename_within":
    git("mv", "tests/test_keep.py", "tests/test_renamed.py")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "rename within test_paths")
elif SCENARIO == "rename_out":
    git("mv", "tests/test_keep.py", "renamed_out_of_scope.py")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "rename out of test_paths")
elif SCENARIO == "eval_case_emptied":
    (ROOT / "evals" / "cases" / "bar" / "only.yaml").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "empty the bar case")
elif SCENARIO == "eval_case_partial":
    (ROOT / "evals" / "cases" / "foo" / "a.yaml").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop one of two files in foo, sibling survives")
elif SCENARIO == "eval_case_dot_rename":
    git("mv", "evals/cases/bar", "evals/cases/.bar")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "rename bar case to a hidden folder")
elif SCENARIO == "unknown_ratchet_inert":
    write(
        change_dir / "plan.md",
        "# Plan: x\n\n## Files that change\n- none\n\n## Proof\n- ratchet: docs may fall, because nothing\n",
    )
    (ROOT / "tests" / "test_keep.py").unlink()
    git("add", ".")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", "drop undeclared, with an irrelevant ratchet: docs line")
else:
    raise SystemExit(f"unknown scenario {SCENARIO}")

ctx = gate.build_context(ROOT, "0001", "c")
res = checks.check_ratchets(ctx)
print(json.dumps({"scenario": SCENARIO, "ok": res.ok, "reason": res.reason, "details": res.details}, indent=2))
PYEOF
echo written
